---
title: "uv-python invalid captioned table with trailing prose"
engine: uv-python
format: html
---

```{python}
#| label: tbl-trailing-prose
#| tbl-cap: This should fail because prose follows the table
from uv_python_runtime import display, Markdown

display(Markdown("""
| item | value |
| --- | ---: |
| table row | 1 |

Trailing prose in the same Markdown display event should be a separate event.
"""))
```
